meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会多一条 Dial 电话号码:能收发短信、接听 AI 语音来电。技能会复制适配器、注册线路、完成手机配对握手,并让你选择只允许自己发短信,还是对任何人开放。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 通过 Dial 号码收发短信或接听电话时会用到;技能会安装适配器、登录 Dial 账户并登记这条线路。

say.text: 把 Dial 号码的来电问候语改成帮我记留言
say.note: 之后拨入的电话按新提示词应答

say.text: 这条线路只允许我自己的手机号发消息
把号码设为公开,谁都能发短信进来
say.note: 每个人各自成为一条会话

howto.what_en: Claude gains a real Dial phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. The skill copies the adapter, registers the line, runs a phone-pairing handshake, and asks whether only you or anyone may text it.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want Claude reachable by text or call on a Dial number; the skill installs the adapter, signs in to Dial and registers the line.

say_en.text: Change the inbound greeting on my Dial number to take a message
say_en.note: Calls in then follow the new prompt

say_en.text: Only my own phone may text this line
Make the number public so anyone can text it
say_en.note: Each texter gets their own thread
